how:
Bring your hands together
Connect with your heart
Experiment with bowing to things animate and inanimate
Spend a few moments throughout your day cultivating a sense of awe, reverence, appreciation and humility
Notice whatever there is to notice
name: Humble Greetings
principle:
You are in me, and I am in you, 
Namaste, the light in me honours the light of the universe in you.
